newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr inches up in Tokyo on Greenspan comment.
newsitem.headline: Dlr inches up in Tokyo on Greenspan comment.

text.p: 0124 GMT --*Dollar inched up in mid-morning Tokyo on short-covering partly due to Fed chairman Greenspan's comments, which market took to mean further rise in U.S. interest rates may be possible. *Earlier, dollar fell vs yen due to comments by Japan's Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka that Japan hopes G7 agreement on forex will be further digested by markets.
